definition: the three things that have to hold before a negative state is legible to me

settled:
Three things all have to hold. The bar has climbed to numbered levels or above. The resource actually has territory below zero rather than bottoming out there. And I have been down in it.

Under that, the descent still happens. I just cannot tell one sub-state from another while it does.

Even at numbered levels the anchors only land if the negative band is reachable and I have reached it.

The reading is moving from afterwards toward live. On one flop day I recognised the full deep periods as they were happening rather than working them out later.

What did that was building the conceptual model of the levels. The map upgraded the instrument, and the recognising is getting automatic through the conceptual route rather than through practice.

title: When I Can Read Below Zero
